summary_paragraph: Mrs. ___ was admitted with nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain, found to be in acute liver and anuric renal failure with altered mental status requiring intubation and dialysis. She had multifocal pneumonia, likely aspiration-related, treated with vancomycin and Zosyn. Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response was managed with diltiazem, metoprolol, and digoxin. Her liver injury improved without a definitive cause identified. She required mechanical ventilation twice but was successfully extubated and weaned. A tunneled dialysis line was placed after infection of the temporary catheter. Her mental status improved with narcotic reduction. She was discharged to extended care still requiring dialysis, with follow-up planned for cardiology, nephrology, vascular, and liver services.
